config.statusBar.description: Show the Companion status bar item with session counters, the longest running turn and usage.
config.sessionStatus.description: Show per-session status counters in the status bar: ~ working, ? waiting for you, V done, ! error.
config.usageInStatusBar.description: Show the Claude 5-hour and 7-day usage percentages in the status bar (refreshed every 5 minutes).
config.soundDone.description: Play a short rising chime when a Claude turn finishes after at least the minimum duration.
config.soundWaiting.description: Play a soft double ping when Claude is waiting for your permission, an answer or a plan approval.
config.soundError.description: Play a descending tone when a Claude turn fails.
config.doneSoundMinSeconds.description: Minimum turn length in seconds for the completion chime; shorter turns stay silent (0 = always play).
config.notifications.description: Show a VS Code notification with the session title when a turn finishes (off by default).
config.alerts.description: Notify when a Claude limit or the DeepSeek balance crosses its alert threshold (once per limit window).
config.alertThreshold5h.description: Alert threshold for the 5-hour limit as a fraction from 0 to 1.
config.alertThreshold7d.description: Alert threshold for the 7-day limit as a fraction from 0 to 1.
config.alertDeepseekBelowUsd.description: Warn when the DeepSeek balance falls below this amount in USD; re-arms after it climbs back to 1.5x the threshold.
config.contextWarnTokens.description: Warn once when a session's context reaches this many tokens (0 = off).
config.manageHooks.description: Add the Companion hooks to ~/.claude/settings.json while VS Code is open and remove them when the last window closes.
config.port.description: Loopback port of the Companion receiver on 127.0.0.1; all VS Code windows share one elected listener.
config.proxy.description: Proxy for api.anthropic.com. Empty = take HTTPS_PROXY / HTTP_PROXY from the environment or from env in ~/.claude/settings.json; "none" = connect directly; or a proxy URL such as http://127.0.0.1:8080.
config.trackNestedSessions.description: Also track nested sessions such as DeepSeek workers or claude -p runs started from a Bash tool (hidden by default).
config.deepseekToggle.description: Show the DeepSeek on/off switch in the Companion menu and in the status bar tooltip. The switch writes or removes the DeepSeek profile through the claude-ds script and applies to new chats.
config.deepseekInStatusBar.description: Show the DeepSeek balance and today's worker spend in the status bar while the DeepSeek routing is on.
config.deepseekScope.description: Which settings file the DeepSeek switch edits: the current folder's .claude/settings.local.json, or the user-wide ~/.claude/settings.json.
config.deepseekScope.project: Current folder (.claude/settings.local.json) — the same file claude-ds on writes.
config.deepseekScope.user: All projects (~/.claude/settings.json) — the same file claude-ds on --user writes.
config.deepseekScript.description: Path to the claude-ds script; empty = <claude dir>/deepseek/claude-ds.mjs. The script owns the DeepSeek key and the backup files, so the companion never writes them itself.
config.tabStatusMarkers.description: Prefix Claude Code tab titles with the session status: [~] working, [?] waiting for you, [V] done, [!] error. Requires a small patch of the Claude Code extension, re-applied automatically after its updates (one window reload each time).
config.projectTabTitle.description: Name Claude Code tabs after the project (workspace). Uses the same patch of the Claude Code extension as the tab status markers.
config.projectTabTitle.always: Always: the tab keeps the project name, the session title does not replace it.
config.projectTabTitle.untitled: Only until the session gets its own title (instead of "Claude Code").
